# Project instructions

- Read only relevant code and guidance; make the smallest safe change and don't guess or refactor unrelated code.
- Preserve security, authorization, accessibility, localization (`$t()`; en/de/fr), and performance.
- Run one focused check.
- Review the diff. Don't commit, push, or discard changes unless asked.
- Guides: [backend](instructions/backend-python-coding-style.instructions.md), [frontend](instructions/frontend-coding-style.instructions.md), [commits](instructions/git-commit-message.instructions.md), [releases](instructions/versioning.md).
